_doc: Per-note level trims in dB, {track: {score onset: dB}} (matched within 0.02 qn), 0 at the onset to the full trim after NOTE_TRIM_RAMP_S (default 0.6 s), held to the note end. c01 (B #5): the opening cello and bass pickup (qn 3) bloomed 10 and 7 dB over the next note's body. c02 (C #6): Violoncellos 680 -6 (the coda solo's first Eb4 bloomed 8-11 dB over the printed bar-174 crest). c05 (B #2, B #5): Bassoon 1 144 -5 and 280 -4 (Sus MAX Gb3/Db4 7.6/6.3 dB over the track's other notes at the same dynamic); Violoncellos 696 -6 (pp G2 5-8 dB over the pp chorale). c06 (critic B #1): brass theme legato notes under 1 qn +3 dB (steps, NOTE_TRIM_RAMP_S 0.1 s) in Horn 1 bars 69-72 and Horn 1/Trumpet 1 bars 167-170, with the accents now at plain velocity + 5 they were 8-14 dB under the accents; (B #2) Oboe 1 578 +8 (the bar-145 pickup 11 dB under the pp strings); (B #6) Horn 1 192 +4, 592 +5 (the re-attacked slur starts of the dolce horn/cello unison 8-12 dB under the celli). c08 (critic B #1): hot f/ff notes, steps (NOTE_TRIM_RAMP_S 0.1 s): Violoncellos A-flat3 100/548/556 -5, 526/272 -3; Oboe 1 F5 95 -3, 99/100 -4, 113 -5, 479 -3, 553 -6, 557 -4; Horn 1 F4 97 -4, 633 -5; Flute 1 G6 118/121.5/482/561.5 -4, 160 -5; Flute 2 E-flat6 285/459 -6; Bass clarinet 284/286 -4, 554 -5; Clarinet 1 414/417 -3, 422 -2; Trombone 1 D4 632/676 -2. (critic A #1) Violins I 59.5 -4, 571.5 -3.5 (merged slur-end Sus MAX notes blooming 4-6 dB over the theme's accents). c26 (critic B #2): Violas 436 +5 -> 0 (the Ab5 stood 9.6 dB over its phrase and 4.1 dB over the mp flute unison in c25), then 3.0 by the c26 stem fix: c25 had played a louder sample on that note (c25 - c24 +4.4 dB with identical data, c26 matches c24), and with 0 the c26 note sat level with its phrase and 5 dB under the flute.
